title.zh-TW: AI股賣壓擴大：那指跌5.28%、費半重挫10.73%
title.en: AI selling deepens: Nasdaq falls 5.28%, chip index plunges 10.73%

summary.zh-TW: 中央社彙整外電，美股20日收黑：道瓊跌949.73點（1.93%）至48,147.33點，標普500跌3.70%至6,910.39點，那斯達克跌5.28%至22,617.73點，費城半導體指數重挫10.73%至8,408.59點。報導將跌勢歸因於AI相關股賣壓持續。
summary.en: CNA, citing wires, reports US stocks closed lower on Nov. 20: the Dow fell 949.73 points (1.93%) to 48,147.33, the S&P 500 lost 3.70% to 6,910.39, the Nasdaq dropped 5.28% to 22,617.73 and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 10.73% to 8,408.59. The report attributes the slide to continued selling of AI-related shares.

impact.zh-TW: 費半單日跌逾一成，週一台股半導體與AI供應鏈可能再承壓；台股週五已先大跌，實際開盤反應仍待觀察，此為推論。
impact.en: With the chip index down more than 10% in a day, Taiwan's semiconductor and AI supply-chain stocks may face more pressure on Monday; Taiwan already fell sharply on Friday, so the actual reaction is uncertain. This is an inference.

title.zh-TW: 台股重挫2,393點收36,033點，三大法人賣超522億元
title.en: TAIEX drops 2,393 points to 36,033; institutions net sell NT$52.2 billion

summary.zh-TW: 中央社報導，加權指數20日跌2,393.60點（6.23%）收36,033.29點，成交8,773.5億元，1,080檔下跌、僅16檔上漲。經濟日報指為史上第三大收盤跌點，台積電收2,000元跌4.76%，聯發科、台達電跌停；三大法人合計賣超522.46億元，其中自營商避險賣超約290億元。資安股逆勢漲停。
summary.en: CNA reports the TAIEX fell 2,393.60 points (6.23%) on Nov. 20 to 36,033.29 on NT$877.35 billion turnover, with 1,080 decliners and 16 gainers. Economic Daily News calls it the third-largest closing point drop: TSMC fell 4.76% to NT$2,000; MediaTek and Delta hit limit-down. Institutions net sold NT$52.246 billion, incl. about NT$29 billion of dealer hedging. Cybersecurity stocks rose limit-up.

impact.zh-TW: 權值股貢獻近半跌點，自營商避險賣壓放大波動；法人動向是觀察賣壓是否延續的指標。資安股逆勢走強反映題材輪動，持續性未確認。
impact.en: Heavyweights accounted for nearly half the drop and dealer hedging amplified the swing; institutional flows are a gauge of whether selling persists. The cybersecurity rally reflects theme rotation whose durability is unconfirmed.

sources.publisher: 經濟日報 via 聯合新聞網 UDN

title.zh-TW: Anthropic 掛牌次日早盤重挫逾9%，仍高於承銷價
title.en: Anthropic falls over 9% in early trade on its second day, still above IPO price

summary.zh-TW: 中央社引法新社報導，Anthropic 表示透過創紀錄 IPO 募得約916億美元；掛牌次日美股開盤後股價一度跌約9.5%至約88美元，低於首日收盤價97.17美元，但仍高於每股83美元承銷價。
summary.en: CNA, citing AFP, says Anthropic reported raising about US$91.6 billion in its record IPO. On its second trading day the stock fell about 9.5% after the open to roughly US$88, below the first-day close of US$97.17 but above the US$83 offer price.

impact.zh-TW: 首日熱度快速降溫，與同日AI股全面賣壓同步，顯示市場對AI評價分歧仍大；新股後續表現可作為AI資金情緒參考，屬推論。
impact.en: The quick fade of first-day enthusiasm coincided with broad AI selling, suggesting wide disagreement over AI valuations; the stock's path may serve as a gauge of AI sentiment, which is an inference.

title.zh-TW: 貝森特：川習同意以AI做重大軍事決策須有人類把關
title.en: Bessent: Trump and Xi agree major AI military decisions need human control

summary.zh-TW: 中央社引路透與CNBC報導，美國財長貝森特表示，川普與習近平同意運用AI的軍事決策必須有人類參與，此共識不受兩國AI競爭影響。他稱輝達H200仍是中國依許可可購買的最先進晶片，中國訂單「相當少」。報導並指美國商務部本週進一步限制中國取得先進AI晶片。
summary.en: CNA, citing Reuters and CNBC, reports Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Trump and Xi agreed that AI-assisted military decisions must involve humans, unaffected by their AI race. He said Nvidia's H200 remains the most advanced chip China can buy under licence and Chinese orders are quite small. The report notes Commerce tightened China's access to advanced AI chips this week.

impact.zh-TW: 美中在AI軍事安全有限度共識，但晶片出口管制持續收緊；貝森特對中國技術落後的說法屬其個人看法，對台灣AI供應鏈的影響仍需觀察。
impact.en: The US and China reached a limited AI military-safety consensus while chip export controls keep tightening; Bessent's view that China lags in chips is his opinion, and effects on Taiwan's AI supply chain remain to be seen.

title.zh-TW: 黃仁勳同意赴美國參院公開作證，間諜疑雲受關注
title.en: Jensen Huang agrees to testify publicly before US Senate amid spy allegations

summary.zh-TW: 中央社彙整外電，參議員史考特辦公室聲明指前輝達執行長黃仁勳同意出席參院公開聽證，日期未定，原請求為12月3日；他也同意12月1日接受眾院三委員會閉門訪談。國會正調查其與一名被指為中國間諜女子的關係；黃仁勳發言人不予置評。
summary.en: CNA, citing wires, says Senator Tim Scott's office stated former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang agreed to a public Senate hearing, date not set, after an original request for Dec. 3; he also agreed to a closed-door interview with three House committees on Dec. 1. Congress is probing his ties to a woman accused of being a Chinese spy; his spokesperson declined comment.

impact.zh-TW: 聽證屬預定活動，尚未發生；指控未經證實。事件涉及AI晶片對中出口審查，可能增加輝達及其供應鏈的不確定性，屬推論。
impact.en: The hearings are scheduled, not yet held, and the allegations are unproven. Because the case touches AI chip exports to China, it may add uncertainty for Nvidia and its suppliers, which is an inference.

reason.zh-TW: 報導指台積電20日盤中低見1,970元、收2,000元跌4.76%，拖累指數約760點；費半同日重挫逾一成，為AI晶片需求情緒的觀察指標。
reason.en: TSMC hit NT$1,970 intraday and closed at NT$2,000, down 4.76%, costing the index about 760 points; the US chip index fell over 10% the same day, a gauge of AI chip sentiment.

risk.zh-TW: 權值比重高，美國半導體股修正與法人賣壓易放大波動；出口管制收緊可能影響客戶出貨。
risk.en: Its heavy index weight means US chip corrections and institutional selling can amplify swings; tighter export controls may affect customer shipments.

reason.zh-TW: 報導指聯發科20日跌停收3,350元，拖累指數約165點，反映AI與高價半導體股遭集中賣壓。
reason.en: MediaTek closed limit-down at NT$3,350 on Nov. 20, costing the index about 165 points, reflecting concentrated selling of AI and high-priced chip stocks.

risk.zh-TW: 高價股流動性與評價調整風險高；費半大跌與AI晶片管制變化可能延續壓力。
risk.en: High-priced shares face liquidity and valuation-reset risk; the US chip rout and AI chip control changes may extend pressure.

reason.zh-TW: 報導指台達電20日跌停收900元，拖累指數約72點；其AI資料中心電源題材與美國AI股賣壓的連動值得觀察，屬產業推論。
reason.en: Delta closed limit-down at NT$900, costing the index about 72 points; how its AI data-center power theme tracks US AI selling is worth watching, an industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: AI基礎建設支出疑慮若擴大，可能壓抑評價；雲端業者資本支出調整將影響需求能見度。
risk.en: Wider doubts over AI infrastructure spending could weigh on valuation; cloud capex adjustments would affect demand visibility.

reason.zh-TW: 報導指日月光投控20日收457元、跌9.33%，拖累指數約59點；先進封裝與AI晶片需求連動高，屬產業推論。
reason.en: ASE closed at NT$457, down 9.33%, costing the index about 59 points; advanced packaging is closely tied to AI chip demand, an industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: 美國出口管制擴及海外代工與封測通路可能增加合規成本；費半修正延續將壓抑評價。
risk.en: US controls reaching overseas foundry and packaging channels may raise compliance costs; a prolonged chip-index correction would weigh on valuation.

reason.zh-TW: 報導指鴻海20日收210元跌4.76%，拖累指數約43點；其AI伺服器業務與輝達相關不確定性的連動值得觀察，屬產業推論。
reason.en: Hon Hai closed at NT$210, down 4.76%, costing the index about 43 points; how its AI server business tracks Nvidia-related uncertainty is worth watching, an industry inference.

risk.zh-TW: AI伺服器出貨可能受出口管制、交貨地點調整及客戶資本支出變化影響；權值股易受法人賣壓衝擊。
risk.en: AI server shipments may be affected by export controls, delivery-site changes and client capex shifts; as a heavyweight it is exposed to institutional selling.
